description: Retrieve aggregated data of a heap dump. Can show biggest objects, retained class lists, and class histograms.

biggestObjectId.description: If view is retained_classes, supply the ID of the biggest object from the biggest_objects view.

packageFilter.description: Optional comma-separated package filter to focus on classes of interest.

view.description: The view type: either biggest_objects (the default) to get a list of biggest objects, retained_classes to show a retained class list for a single biggest object, or classes for a class histogram for the complete heap.

name: get_heap_data
